label: 5-minute VWAP estimate
source_note: Yahoo Finance unadjusted 5-minute HLC3 weighted by bar volume; an estimate, not reported trade VWAP or company issuance proceeds. Only retrieved regular-session bars are included, with no claim of full SIP coverage. Bars exclude the bar beginning at the close; closing-auction coverage follows the source's timestamps, and volume may differ from end-of-day daily bars.
